name: MomSpawnSphereUnit
signature: void_f(int_t p_13, int_t unitType, int_t rung)
purpose: spawn a sphere unit on a free non-water NEIGHBOUR of the first city, never the city tile: CTP2 draws exactly ONE unit per tile and orders own units by MaxMovePoints, so a fast summon on the capital permanently hides the garrison. GetNeighbor returns 0 at the map edge and does not write its out-arg, so the return value gates the read.

purpose: per-turn mana accrual into MomMagicCur, clamped at the per-sphere MomMagicMax ceiling (200-300, set by MomMagicSchoolGrant; 100 only as the pre-grant default). The old pool-overflow auto-summon is REMOVED: it zeroed the pool on cap, so the 50/100-cost workings were unreachable by construction.

name: mod_CanPlayerHaveAdvance
purpose: deny a tribe every ladder advance outside its own sphere. Guards on g.player FIRST (ResetCanResearch calls this once per advance per player) and intercepts every acquisition path including scenario-start seeding, so seed advances are unnecessary.

name: mod_CanCityBuildUnit
purpose: deny a city any unit whose sphere is not its owner tribe; neutral units always permitted. Identity via theCity.owner (proven to resolve, probe B2).

name: mod_CanCityBuildBuilding
purpose: same wall for improvements: deny off-sphere buildings, permit neutral ones.

name: mod_CanCityBuildWonder
purpose: same wall for wonders.
